{{Top|notoc=1}}
'''Plankton''' were very small organisms that lived in the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and [[Baralou]]. [[Whaladon/Legends|Whaladons]] preyed on them.

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
[[Fluorescent plankton]] were cited in a song called "[[If Only I Could Let Go and Cry]]."<ref name="MAGL">''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]''</ref>
{{Noncanonend}}
